A1.justification: Both complete 27-page PDFs describe the same GIST research. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–G support reliable comparison despite changes in layout.

before.justification: v1 reports original graph-classification experiments, counterfactual-quality measurements, and spectral and sensitivity analyses in Section 5 and Appendix G.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary experiments in Appendix G.

M1.justification: The overshooting procedure, transformer architecture, edge sampling, losses, and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. Figure 2 removes an erroneous dependency arrow to agree with the existing Laplacian definitions; this does not establish a change to the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions contain the same eight main graph-classification benchmarks, supplementary MUTAG and IMDB-M evaluations, reported unsuccessful NCI1 experiments, and spectral test scenarios. The appendix coverage was already present in v1.

E2.justification: The corresponding benchmark tables retain iRand, CF-GNNExp., CF2, CLEAR, and RSGG-CE as comparators. The GCN and U2GNN investigations in Appendices G.5–G.6 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported 90:10 train-test split, validation allocation, three-layer GCN oracle, default alpha of 0.9, evaluation metrics, and Appendix C training settings remain unchanged. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix G retain the same interpolation sensitivity, spectral alignment, connectivity, Frobenius-norm, and alpha=0.5 versus alpha=0.9 analyses. Repositioning the plots introduces no additional analysis.

E5.justification: Five-fold cross-validation reporting and existing uncertainty displays are unchanged. Neither version adds or revises seed information, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures relative to the other.

E6.justification: The reported results in Tables 1–2 and 5–14 and the empirical figures are unchanged. For example, GIST's BBBP validity/fidelity remain 0.956/0.809, and its IMDB-M values remain 0.870/0.170. The spectral errors and qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, spectral results, Appendix A proofs, and Appendix F complexity derivations are unchanged. The Figure 2 correction aligns the illustration with existing mathematics without revising a definition or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about inverse style transfer, backtracking, spectral guarantees, and empirical superiority, including the stated 7.6% validity and 45.5% fidelity improvements.

C2.justification: The interpretations of spectral alignment and validity-distance trade-offs, limitations at equal content/style weighting, and multiclass and oracle-quality qualifications are unchanged. The new figure note restates a computational dependency already specified by the Laplacian definitions.

D1.justification: The code-access information, hardware and execution-time disclosure, Appendix C hyperparameters, and Appendix G.5 centrality-feature construction remain unchanged. The corrected diagram supplies no implementation detail beyond the existing definitions.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, novelty positioning, and appendix critiques of prior benchmarking are unchanged. References reflow across pages without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short explanatory correction to the Figure 2 caption and running title headers. The substantive prose and section organization remain unchanged, with limited reflow caused by the longer caption.

P2.justification: Figure 2 removes the dashed arrow from X* to the generated graph's Laplacian and adds a red correction notice explaining that Laplacians do not require node features. Running headers and float placement also change, including repositioning Figures 5–6; the empirical displays retain their content.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects a misleading dependency in the central architecture diagram and explicitly explains the correction, making Figure 2 consistent with the existing Laplacian definitions. This improves explanatory accuracy, while the method, theory, empirical evidence, and appendices remain unchanged.
